title: operatingConditions
description: Operating conditions (ambient + cooling) shared by all component families (CAS, SAS, RAS, MAS). The cooling method is the standardized PEAS cooling type, utils.json#/$defs/cooling, so cooling is described identically wherever it appears across the OpenConverters families.

name.description: A label that identifies this Operating Conditions

ambientTemperature.description: Temperature of the ambient where the component will operate, in Celsius

ambientRelativeHumidity.description: Relative Humidity of the ambient where the component will operate
